The '''Harterra system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Gallinore Reach]] to the [[Selab system/Legends|Selab]] and [[Ut system/Legends|Ut systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Harterra [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Harterran moonstone]]|system=Harterra [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] known as [[Harterran moonstone]],<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> and it also shared its name with the [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] [[Shard of Harterra]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=item|[[Shard of Harterra]]|The Grand Acquisitions Race}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Harterra [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
